# AND Gate Project

# Title: AND Gate Using Push Buttons

## Aim:

To construct an AND gate using two push buttons and an LED.

## Components:

# 

*  9V battery  
* 2 push buttons   
* LED  
* Resistor  
* Connecting wires  
* Perfboard  
* Solder 

### Truth Table:

|    A |     B | Output |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
|     0 |     0 | OFF |
|     0 |     1 | OFF |
|     0 |     0 | OFF |
|     0 |     1 | ON |

## Working:

The two push buttons act as inputs. The LED glows only when both buttons are pressed, demonstrating AND logic.

### Application:

Used in digital circuits, control systems, automation, and safety systems.

### Result:

The AND gate was successfully constructed and its operation was verified using the LED.
